title: The catch and the meal differ
literal_meaning: The Keuta catches fish but eats crab.
explanation: The contrast suggests that producing something does not ensure enjoying it oneself. The line can point to a gap between someone’s work and their own circumstances.
meaning_odia: ଯାହା ନିଜେ ଯୋଗାଉଛି, ସେହି ଜିନିଷ ନିଜ ଭାଗରେ ପଡ଼ୁନାହିଁ—କାମ ଓ ନିଜ ଅବସ୍ଥାର ତଫାତ ଏଠି ଦେଖାଯାଏ।
usage_example: A carpenter makes fine cabinets for customers while keeping a broken cupboard at home. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: Editorial reading of an unglossed line. Keuta is retained from the witness; this is not evidence about a community’s diet, poverty or food preferences.
